workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: MRV2 extensible KV cache commits all KV before encoder CUDA graph capture, so cudagraph_mm_encoder OOMs at startup
workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix] Extensible KV cache: release warmup's blocks before CUDA graph capture. Target files: vllm/v1/worker/extensible_kv_cache.py, vllm/v1/worker/gpu/cudagraph_utils.py, vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py. . With the extensible KV cache (the MRV2 default), large CUDA graphs such as encoder graphs could crash startup with CUDA OOM, because warmup's KV blocks still took the memory capture needed. Release those blocks before capture. `extend_kv_cache` then commits the size measured after capture, as it does today. (Ref: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/66523)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: [Bugfix] Skip more weight formats in the tokenizer/processor snapshot. Target files: pyproject.toml, vllm/transformers_utils/repo_utils.py.
